name: koralpaper
description: Let Claude design diagrams, decks and carousels directly on your KoralPaper paper.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the KoralPaper app running in your browser. Describe a diagram, a deck or a carousel in plain words and Claude draws it as fully editable elements. Claude works in its own document so it never draws over other work, refuses to overwrite a page you changed since it last read it, measures real text so copy fits its box, uses named styles and a master page with automatic page numbers, reads and answers comments you pin to elements, and exports PDF, PNG or JPG into a folder inside Documents. Nothing leaves your machine except your conversation with Claude.
